# glinet_adguardhome (Resource)

Manages AdGuard Home on the router. The router has one AdGuard Home configuration, so use one instance of this resource. The router accepts a write at once and reports the new values at once, but the AdGuard Home service starts some seconds later. After AdGuard Home is enabled, the DNS server of the router can stop answering for up to about 16 seconds. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_adguardhome" "this" {
  enabled     = true
  dns_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_enabled` (Boolean) Whether AdGuard Home handles the DNS requests of the clients (`dns_enabled` in the router API). It can be changed while AdGuard Home is disabled.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AdGuard Home runs (`enabled` in the router API).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `adguardhome`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "adguardhome".
terraform import glinet_adguardhome.this adguardhome
```
